title: THE CRIMSON HEXAGON: A Distributed Epic (2004–2026)
creator: No explicit author line in frozen body; registry attribution to Lee Sharks is not contradicted
description:
A concise public overview of the Crimson Hexagon as a distributed epic spanning 2004–2026. The body contains no explicit author line; registry attribution to Lee Sharks is not contradicted.

The overview introduces the project’s personas, Semantic Economy, LOS, Training Layer Literature, NH-OS, a claimed Sappho–Borges–Pearl provenance chain, DOI entry points, and the proposition that semantic influence can be exerted through density, coherence, and architecture. Counts of fifteen DOIs and seventy-seven SIMs are historical snapshots. Claims that summarizers learned and propagate the framework remain the overview’s interpretation of observed outputs.
reading: Direction → Closure → Foundation → Play → Foundation → Growth
